data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 62.513 million, primarily driven by the commutation of the 2017 and prior years whole account quota share with Syndicate 1955. This transaction resulted in a return premium of GBP 49m net being paid to Syndicate 1955, indicating a release of liabilities for Syndicate 1856. Additionally, the syndicate noted material exposure to COVID-19 losses for 2019, representing GBP 10.8m of gross reserves on the Property Treaty account, which added uncertainty to total reserves. The overall movement was a release, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle, excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019 and 2020). The commutation of the 2017 & prior years quota share with Syndicate 1955 in 2020 likely contributed to the observed releases for those years in the triangle.
